about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS DEMO

Command your squad and shape the battlefield in ARBO: Arena Tactics DEMO — a tactical, turn-based strategy game where four rival factions clash across a fractured galaxy.

This free demo lets you experience ARBO: Arena Tactics’s unique blend of hex-grid tactics, card-driven abilities, and AI-assisted combat, featuring early access to several maps, game modes, and cosmetics from the full game.

OVERVIEW

An unknown saboteur has breached the Bastion stronghold on Earth. Rally your squad, fortify your defenses, and step into the heart of tactical warfare. Command your team in strategic, turn-based battles, unleashing powerful Protocol Cards to turn the tide.

Recruit your first squad of elite mercenaries, expand your arsenal of tactics, and prove your command against AI adversaries or rival players on the frontlines of ARBO: Arena Tactics.

KEY DEMO FEATURES

  • Forge your Mercenary Crew - Lead a custom 3-member squad of tanks, assassins, spellcasters, and hybrids, each offering a new path to tactical mastery.

  • Build your Arsenal:  Discover and collect powerful Protocol Cards that unlock new tactics. Unleash chaotic energy, summon swarms of minions, or command advanced weaponry from distant worlds.

  • Dominate Across Game Modes:

    • Tactical Combat : Take control in turn-based tactical combat, mastering positioning, timing, and ability synergy to outthink every rival

    • Prompt Battler: Command your mercenaries from the backline in this hands-off mode. Watch your AI squad execute your tactics and challenge rival AIs.

    • Incursions : Form the perfect strategy to overcome deadly foes and intense skirmishes across the system.

  • 3 Playable Maps: Battle across the ice-encrusted Vale of Midir, the lava-soaked Abyssal Pit, and the scorched warzone of Recruit’s Ascent.

  • Dynamic Arenas: Engage with destructible obstacles, terrain effects (ice, lava, tar, etc.), and different win conditions that change how every match unfolds.

  • First-Time User Tutorial: Learn core combat, deck-building, and energy mechanics through an interactive onboarding experience.

  • Leaderboards: Track wins, ELO, and daily challenge standings to prove your tactical mastery.

  • Cosmetics & Unlockables: Earn visual upgrades and customization items as you play.

Average playtime: 15–30 minutes, depending on match length and experimentation.

NOT INCLUDED IN THIS DEMO

This free demo focuses on showcasing ARBO’s core tactical systems and early gameplay experience. The following content will be available in the full game:

  • Expanded Campaign & Story Progression: uncover the full narrative arc across multiple factions and worlds.

  • Advanced Cosmetic Customization: personalize your Heroes, Squads, and Bases with skins, effects, and visual upgrades.

  • Additional Maps & Holomotion Protocols: explore new Arenas and unlock a wider range of advanced tactical abilities.

  • More Protocol Cards & Trait Ops: Access the full roster of card-based powers and unit traits for even deeper squad-building possibilities.
